name: ALS 15181 (Webb)
blurb: ALS 15181, a B-type star toward the Cygnus OB2 association, seen by Webb.
label: als15181-webb
story: Webb looked toward this star to read the faint fingerprints that thin dust drifting between the stars leaves in its light. It is one of a dozen O and B stars chosen to study the Milky Way's diffuse interstellar dust.

claims.text: ALS 15181 is a B star (B0 V)
ALS 15181 is also designated [MT91] 435 and 2MASS J20331106+4110321
It was included (as [MT91] 435) in a survey of the Cygnus OB2 association
Program 2183 groups ALS 15181 among its Cygnus targets
The program detects the absorption fingerprint of diffuse interstellar dust in the light of background O and B stars
It is one of twelve O and B stars in the program
